shortDescription: Independent, challengeable consumer warranty and product defect coverage adjudication on GenLayer Studionet.
detailedDescription: WarrantyLens is a standalone GenLayer Intelligent Contract that automates retail and consumer warranty claim adjudication without subjective human dispute desks or custodial escrow risk. It enforces an immutable two-party lifecycle: terms are sealed with explicit counterparty consent and a distinct independent attestor. Claims require evidence commitment before semantic review. GenLayer validators independently evaluate three strict boolean predicates (defect_matches_coverage, excluded_cause_proven, evidence_sufficient). Both parties hold distinct challenge rights, prompting a second-round multi-validator deliberation before deterministic finalization.
problemSolved: Consumer warranty disputes inherently suffer from unilateral rejection, hidden exclusion clauses, and lack of verifiable audit trails. WarrantyLens enforces cryptographic commitment of warranty rules, independent third-party evidence attestation, and transparent consensus-driven coverage interpretation.
whyThisRequiresGenLayer: Determining whether a reported product malfunction matches written policy coverage or falls under an exclusion clause requires natural-language comprehension of policy text and technical diagnostic reports. Traditional smart contracts cannot interpret unstructured diagnostic logs or policies; GenLayer validators independently evaluate equivalence principle prompts and reach deterministic consensus over bounded boolean predicates.
genuineSemanticConsensus: Leader and validators independently execute non-comparative equivalence principle prompts in gl.vm.run_nondet_unsafe, returning a strict boolean schema (defect_matches_coverage, excluded_cause_proven, evidence_sufficient). If validators disagree on any predicate, the transaction fails closed, preventing biased or uncoordinated state changes. Reconsidered challenges trigger a second consensus round before closing the case.
securityAndQualificationSummary: Full regression suite passes 22 mock contract tests and 14 adversarial hardening tests. Automated live end-to-end audit passes all on-chain checks against Studionet (Chain 61999). Zero secret leaks across all files. Hash-linked audit lineage is cryptographically intact across all historical rounds.
reviewerInstructions: Open https://explorer-studio.genlayer.com/address/0xebe45565311A00A148e4469dF38aC6aB73eFdb89 to inspect the verified contract. Run `node tests/test_live_e2e.mjs` to execute live on-chain reads and verify cryptographic source byte parity, canonical case GNEW-warrantylens-39240970537 finality, and 2-round audit history lineage.
knownLimitationsAndExternalTrustAssumpti: Attestor wallet signature confirms authorized witness attribution, not real-world identity or physical product inspection. No escrow, automatic payment, or physical replacement is performed. Storage is append-only on Studionet.
whyGenLayer: Validators independently assess policy clauses and claim evidence using GenLayer nondeterministic prompts with strict boolean schemas.
semanticConsensus: Leader and validators independently classify defect_matches_coverage, excluded_cause_proven, and evidence_sufficient.
